title: Factorization through affine space of relative dimension r with unramified projection at a point
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism of affine schemes f: X to S and a point x, the lemma factors f as X to A^r_S to S with the first arrow unramified at x, where r is the dimension over kappa(x) of the fibre of the differentials (statement lines 3470-3485). The proof first makes sense of r: finiteness of the dimension comes from finite type of the differentials module, the identification with the fibre restricted module from base change of differentials, and the identification with the tangent space from the cotangent-space lemma (proof lines 3487-3495). The construction is then algebraic and explicit: write S = Spec(A), X = Spec(B), choose a surjection A[x_1,...,x_t] to B, renumber so that the images of dx_1,...,dx_r form a basis of the fibre of Omega_{B/A} at q, set P = A[x_1,...,x_r], and show Omega_{B/P,q} = 0 by Nakayama, since Omega_{B/P} is finite and its fibre at q vanishes by the choice of the variables; vanishing of the module of differentials is the criterion for unramifiedness (proof lines 3498-3517). The claim is H2: two standard identifications followed by an explicit renumbering-and-Nakayama argument.
